title: ADK agent feedback record
description: Structured log record for user or operator feedback on one agent invocation. Keyed by the same opaque identifiers as spans (gen_ai.conversation.id, gcp.vertex.agent.invocation_id) and BigQuery Agent Analytics rows (session_id, invocation_id). Free text retains personal data until redacted; apply the project's protect-adk-sensitive-data policy before storage or omit it.

user_id.description: Opaque application user key; never an email address or display name.

score.description: Choose one scale per deployment: -1/1 or 1 to 5.

text.description: Optional free text; redact before storage.
